note: Family-run RV park under new ownership on the south bank of the Oldman River at the edge of Fort Macleod, beside Highway 3; shaded by cottonwoods, with a river swimming area and propane sales. Riverfront sites sit on the bank. RV rentals, tent sites and an Airbnb apartment on site; RV storage. --Claude
